source.note: Imported source claims are evidence leads, not verified product truth.

entries.title: Autosave
entries.professionalImpact: Work is only as safe as the last manual save. Every comparable tool writes a recovery copy on a timer and on focus loss.
entries.evidenceProse: No autosave timer exists anywhere in the app; the only occurrence of the word is a comment in src/lib/projectLibrary.ts:122.

entries.title: Crash recovery of unsaved documents
entries.professionalImpact: After a crash, reopen and get the document back — not an empty canvas.
entries.evidenceProse: src/components/Recovery/ contains only ErrorBoundary.tsx. No journal, scratch snapshot, or restore-on-launch path.

entries.title: Pointer drag-trim on clip edges
entries.professionalImpact: Grab a cut and drag it. Today trimming is keyboard-only, which reads to an editor as broken rather than unfinished.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:845 still open — trimEdit.ts math is described as the ready engine; Q/W/E keyboard trim shipped instead.

entries.title: Undo and redo in Flow
entries.professionalImpact: Every other workspace has undo. Rewiring a graph is destructive and currently irreversible.
entries.evidenceProse: edit:undo is handled by App.tsx, ImageEditorWorkspace and PaperWorkspace; paperStore is the only store with an undo history. No flow history store exists.

entries.title: Project version history and named snapshots
entries.professionalImpact: Revert to yesterday's cut, compare two versions, branch a variant without cloning the file.
entries.evidenceProse: versionHistory appears only in ImageSourceDocument.ts. No project-level version store.

entries.title: Projects that stay a sane size
entries.professionalImpact: Embedded base64 assets are 97–98% of .sloom file size, so real projects become slow to open and impossible to send.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:507 open — externalize embedded assets, measured on the Root & Relay and Weights & Measures projects.

entries.title: Customizable keyboard shortcuts
entries.professionalImpact: Pros remap keys and carry muscle memory between apps. A Photoshop/Premiere/InDesign keymap preset removes the first day of friction.
entries.evidenceProse: No shortcut-remapping or keybinding-editor code found across src and electron.

entries.title: True Smart Objects and smart filters
entries.professionalImpact: Place once, scale freely, replace contents, edit the original, re-open filter settings later.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity smart-source-linked-layers scores 63: "true native Smart Object semantics, Embedded native Smart Objects, and native smart filters are not implemented."

entries.title: 16- and 32-bit per channel documents
entries.professionalImpact: Anything graded, composited, or destined for print degrades in 8-bit. Banding shows in every gradient.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity bit-depth-workflow scores 32: "true high-bit document storage, edits, filters, and export remain missing."

entries.title: Real CMYK document mode with ICC conversion
entries.professionalImpact: Print work lives in CMYK. Converting only at export means the artist never sees what the press will print.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity color-management 55 and cmyk-lab-grayscale 46: "true ICC conversion, separations, profile transforms… native CMYK export remain missing."

entries.title: A print job that a real shop has accepted
entries.professionalImpact: PDF/X, spot plates and KDP output have never been through an actual RIP, Acrobat preflight, or printed proof.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/861: validated only by our own tooling plus Ghostscript; the KDP pipeline has a landing page and zero real proof copies.

entries.title: Signed and notarized installers
entries.professionalImpact: On macOS and Windows an unsigned build shows a scary warning. Professionals on managed machines simply cannot install it.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/861 lists unsigned/un-notarized Windows and macOS installers among its high-risk rows.

entries.title: Screen-reader and keyboard accessibility
entries.professionalImpact: Studios and public-sector clients increasingly require it, and a keyboard-only path is a working requirement, not a courtesy.
entries.evidenceProse: No aria-live, screen-reader or a11y handling found; docs/notes/861 lists app-wide accessibility as never audited.

entries.title: Crash reporting
entries.professionalImpact: Without it, a crash on a client's machine is invisible and unfixable.
entries.evidenceProse: No crash reporter, Sentry, Breakpad, or minidump handling found; docs/notes/861 treats it as absent.

entries.title: Timeline and clip markers with labels and colours
entries.professionalImpact: Notes, sync points, and client feedback all hang off markers.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:846 open, carried over from the ranked gap audit in docs/notes/808 (need 74/100).

entries.title: Audio crossfades per cut
entries.professionalImpact: Video has opacity ramps; audio cuts still pop.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:846 open (need 72/100 in docs/notes/808).

entries.title: Waveforms on video clips' embedded audio
entries.professionalImpact: Standalone audio clips draw peaks; audio living inside a video clip does not, so sync-by-eye fails.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:846 lists this as the remaining sliver of the waveform work.

entries.title: A real colour grading workspace
entries.professionalImpact: Lift/gamma/gain wheels, curves, secondary/HSL qualifiers. Clip colour today is exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature, tint and a LUT reference.
entries.evidenceProse: src/lib/videoColorPipeline.ts carries the correction model and LUT reference; TASK_LIST.md:18 names "real Color/Audio/VFX workspaces" as remaining. No colour wheels or qualifiers exist.

entries.title: Scopes driven by decoded frames
entries.professionalImpact: A waveform or vectorscope is only useful if it reads the actual picture.
entries.evidenceProse: Scope handling appears only inside src/lib/videoColorPipeline.ts as pipeline stages; there is no scope panel fed from decoded pixels.

entries.title: A real audio mixer
entries.professionalImpact: Channel strips, per-track EQ and compression, buses, and meters. The engine exists; the desk does not.
entries.evidenceProse: src/lib/videoAudioMixer.ts (407 lines) is engine-only; TASK_LIST.md:18 lists the Audio workspace as remaining.

entries.title: Loudness normalization and true-peak limiting
entries.professionalImpact: Every platform and broadcaster specifies a LUFS target. Delivering without it means rejection.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999 honest boundaries: true-peak and related analysis "still needs native decoded-media analyzers."

entries.title: Speed ramping that actually renders
entries.professionalImpact: Retiming state is persisted; keyframed ramps do not execute in the monitor or the export.
entries.evidenceProse: Retiming appears across ~10 runtime modules as state and planning; TASK_LIST.md:18 keeps the executing Runtime IR as remaining work.

entries.title: Nested sequences and adjustment layers that execute
entries.professionalImpact: Both are represented in the project model but do not composite in the Program Monitor or on export.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:18: remaining work is "one monitor/export Runtime IR for linked/nested/adjustment/multicam/transcript editing."

entries.title: Relink and consolidate offline media
entries.professionalImpact: When a file moves, the project must be repairable rather than broken.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:18 states remaining program work "starts with relink/consolidation UI."

entries.title: Transcript-based editing
entries.professionalImpact: Cut dialogue by deleting words. For interview and narration work this is now the expected default.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:18 lists transcript editing among the remaining Runtime IR work.

entries.title: Multicam switching in playback and export
entries.professionalImpact: The multicam model is persisted; live angle switching and flattening are not runnable.
entries.evidenceProse: Multicam appears in ~6 runtime modules as state; TASK_LIST.md:18 lists multicam among the remaining Runtime IR work.

entries.title: A render queue that survives a restart
entries.professionalImpact: Queue tonight's deliveries, close the laptop, come back to finished files.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999: "A restart-safe background queue needs native persisted scheduling over immutable render snapshots." No export/render queue module exists.

entries.title: Result caching and partial rerun
entries.professionalImpact: Change one prompt at the end of a graph and every upstream paid node runs again.
entries.evidenceProse: src/store/flowStore.ts:434 — shouldReuseExistingNodeOutput returns false unconditionally, by design, so a root run re-executes the whole dependency traversal.

entries.title: Enforced spend caps
entries.professionalImpact: Estimation and a usage ledger exist, but nothing stops a runaway loop at a dollar limit.
entries.evidenceProse: src/lib/costEstimation.ts estimates and confirms cost; no budget ceiling blocks execution.

entries.title: Font discovery and management
entries.professionalImpact: Image cannot see the fonts installed on the machine, and there is no activation, substitution, or per-client collection across the suite.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72: "installed-font discovery… still lag badly." Managed-font handling exists only as a Video registration gate.

entries.title: Bézier text on a path
entries.professionalImpact: Type follows only straight segments today. Comic and poster lettering needs curves.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72 names "Bezier text-on-path editing" as missing; only straight-segment attachment is retained.

entries.title: Editable text warps
entries.professionalImpact: Arc, bulge, flag — reversible, still-editable type distortion.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72 lists "editable text warps" as missing.

entries.title: Spellcheck in Image type
entries.professionalImpact: Typos in shipped lettering are expensive and embarrassing.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72 lists "dictionary spellcheck" as missing; spellcheck exists only in Paper's story editor.

entries.title: Vertical Japanese type in Image
entries.professionalImpact: Paper handles 縦書き properly; Image, where the lettering is actually drawn, does not.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72 lists "vertical type" as missing. Paper's vertical writing shipped via writing-mode on the frame content container.

entries.title: Canvas view rotation
entries.professionalImpact: Rotate the view, not the artwork, so a hand can draw a comfortable arc. Standard in every drawing app.
entries.evidenceProse: No canvas view-rotation handling found in the Image editor's gesture or camera code.

entries.title: PSD export with live editable text
entries.professionalImpact: Any handoff to a client or collaborator flattens the type, so the other side cannot fix a typo.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity text-tool 72 and psd-roundtrip 60: "native PSD editable text export" missing.

entries.title: PSD round-trip that keeps structure editable
entries.professionalImpact: Groups, effects, adjustment layers, masks and smart objects should survive both directions.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity file-interop 61: "native PSD Smart Object/editable text/adjustment/effect/mask/filter constructs remain flattened/partial."

entries.title: XCF import
entries.professionalImpact: GIMP files are recognised and then refused.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity xcf-interoperability 42: "XCF import is explicitly detected but not decoded."

entries.title: Nested groups with pass-through blending
entries.professionalImpact: Deep layer organisation is how large comic and composite files stay navigable.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity layer-groups 55: "nested group UI, pass-through blending fidelity, live group masks… remain incomplete."

entries.title: Transforming several layers as one
entries.professionalImpact: Select five layers, scale them together, keep relative positions.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity layer-stack 76: "full multi-select linked-transform semantics remain incomplete."

entries.title: A magnetic lasso that actually snaps to edges
entries.professionalImpact: Cutting a figure out of a background is the single most common retouching task.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity lasso 57: "true image-edge magnetic snapping and refinement workflows remain missing."

entries.title: Select Subject that works offline and well
entries.professionalImpact: The lowest-scoring capability in the whole Image parity table.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity select-subject-object 31: the cloud route is blocked without a configured provider; the local fallback is luminance-based.

entries.title: Puppet Warp and Perspective Warp
entries.professionalImpact: Repose a limb, straighten a building. There is no mesh interface at all.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity puppet-warp-advanced-warp 36: "no mesh UI, on-canvas pin editor, true live triangulated Puppet Warp, Perspective Warp plane handles… exists yet."

entries.title: Perspective crop
entries.professionalImpact: Straighten a photographed page or panel in one step.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity crop 66 names perspective crop as incomplete.

entries.title: Content-aware fill of corners after straightening
entries.professionalImpact: Rotate to level and the corners come back transparent, needing manual repair every time.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity crop 66: "true content-aware fill of transparent corners remain incomplete."

entries.title: Content-aware fill with real controls
entries.professionalImpact: Editable sampling area, live patch source, output to a new layer.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity content-aware-fill-remove-patch 54: "editable sampling-area preview, live manual patch-source controls, output-to-new-layer… remain missing."

entries.title: Professional path editing
entries.professionalImpact: Curvature pen, smooth/corner anchor conversion, and separate Direct and Path Selection tools.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity pen-tool 49 and path-anchor-editing 51: "curvature mode, anchor conversion… independent direct/path selection tools… remain missing."

entries.title: Work paths and saved paths independent of layers
entries.professionalImpact: Reusable paths for selections, strokes and masks are a core vector workflow.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity paths-panel 64: "true work paths, saved paths independent of layers… remain missing."

entries.title: Smart filter masks
entries.professionalImpact: Paint where a non-destructive filter applies instead of committing it everywhere.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity layer-filters 60: "smart-filter masks, richer filter families, and deeper preview/control parity remain incomplete."

entries.title: LUT and gradient-map adjustment layers
entries.professionalImpact: Look development and duotone work both start here. Video carries a LUT reference model; Image has none.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity adjustment-layers 71: "native PSD/Camera Raw/LUT/gradient-map adjustment execution… remain incomplete."

entries.title: Advanced blending and the missing adjustment staples
entries.professionalImpact: Blend If, Bevel & Emboss, channel mixer, selective colour, and layer comps — each a routine part of retouch and comic colour work.
entries.evidenceProse: The eight shipped adjustment kinds skip these; Bevel & Emboss is the one Photoshop layer effect not implemented.

entries.title: GPU live preview while adjusting
entries.professionalImpact: Dragging a curve on a large file should update immediately, not after the release.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity adjustment-layers 71 names GPU live preview and live preview visualization as incomplete.

entries.title: A histogram that updates as you work
entries.professionalImpact: A static histogram cannot guide an exposure or levels decision.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity histogram-panel 53: "live preview wiring remains incomplete."

entries.title: Live boolean operations on vector shapes
entries.professionalImpact: Combine, subtract and intersect shapes and still be able to change your mind.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity custom-vector-shapes 52: "overlapping polygon/Bezier booleans, and retained live boolean operation stacks remain missing."

entries.title: Custom shape libraries
entries.professionalImpact: Balloon tails, panel furniture, logo marks — saved once, reused everywhere.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity custom-vector-shapes 52: "native custom-shape library instances, broader shape libraries… remain missing."

entries.title: Background Eraser and Magic Eraser
entries.professionalImpact: The fast path for knocking out a flat background.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity eraser 52: "Background Eraser and Magic Eraser mask/channel/QuickMask routes remain missing."

entries.title: Mask refinement workspace and linked masks
entries.professionalImpact: Hair and fur edges need a refine pass; linked masks keep a mask travelling with its layer.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity layer-masks 71: "refine workspace and true linked-mask workflows remain incomplete."

entries.title: Spot channels and press-ready separations
entries.professionalImpact: Spot inks and separation proofs are what a comic or poster printer actually asks for.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity channels 63 and channels-panel-alpha 65: "native spot plates, and press-ready separations remain missing."

entries.title: Print output from Image artboards
entries.professionalImpact: Bleed, slices, printer marks, PDF/X and a packaged folder, without exporting through Paper.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity artboards-print-proof 48: "bleed extension, slices, printer marks, PDF-X, packaged print folders, ICC conversion/embedding… remain unsupported."

entries.title: Unattended batch actions over a folder
entries.professionalImpact: Record once, run on two hundred files overnight.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity actions-batch-processor 64: "actual unattended native execution, import/export UI… real filesystem execution logs remain incomplete."

entries.title: Camera Raw development
entries.professionalImpact: RAW files are detected and politely refused rather than developed.
entries.evidenceProse: Parity camera-raw 34: detection, policy descriptors and "a clear unsupported import path" only.

entries.title: Photographic correction
entries.professionalImpact: Lens profile distortion, chromatic aberration, defringe, and denoise.
entries.evidenceProse: No lens-correction, chromatic-aberration, defringe or denoise filters found in the Image editor; the only denoise reference is a Flow node name.

entries.title: HDR merge, panorama stitch, focus stacking
entries.professionalImpact: The three standard multi-shot photographic compositing jobs.
entries.evidenceProse: No HDR-merge, panorama-stitch or focus-stack implementations found.

entries.title: Frame animation and onion skinning
entries.professionalImpact: Animatics, motion comics, GIF work and any hand-drawn animation all need a frame timeline with onion skin.
entries.evidenceProse: No onion-skin handling found anywhere in the repository; Image has no animation timeline.

entries.title: A vector design discipline
entries.professionalImpact: Precise Béziers, shape builder, symbols, scalable effects and clean SVG/PDF round-trip — logo, cover and packaging work has nowhere to live.
entries.evidenceProse: Vector capability is split across Image's paths and shapes (parity 49–52 and 68) and Paper's frames; there is no vector design workspace.

entries.title: Table of contents, index and cross-references
entries.professionalImpact: Every book-length document needs generated navigation whose page numbers update themselves.
entries.evidenceProse: No table-of-contents, index-marker or cross-reference implementations found in Paper; every xref hit is PDF file structure.

entries.title: Footnotes and endnotes you can author
entries.professionalImpact: Footnotes exist only as an imported artefact, not as something you can create in Paper.
entries.evidenceProse: Only occurrence is the DOCX import model — src/lib/paperDocumentFormats.ts:83 footnoteRefs.

entries.title: Anchored objects that flow with text
entries.professionalImpact: Figures, sidebars and inline panels must move when the text reflows.
entries.evidenceProse: No anchored-object or inline-anchor handling found.

entries.title: GREP and nested styles
entries.professionalImpact: Automatic formatting by pattern — the feature that makes long-document typesetting survivable.
entries.evidenceProse: No GREP-style or nested-style implementation found.

entries.title: Text variables and conditional text
entries.professionalImpact: Running heads, chapter names, and one document producing several editions.
entries.evidenceProse: No text-variable or conditional-text handling found.

entries.title: Data merge
entries.professionalImpact: Catalogue pages, card decks, certificates, personalised print runs.
entries.evidenceProse: No data-merge or mail-merge implementation found.

entries.title: Book files across multiple documents
entries.professionalImpact: A graphic novel is chapters. They need synchronised styles and continuous page numbering across files.
entries.evidenceProse: No book-file or multi-document-book handling found.

entries.title: Object libraries and snippets
entries.professionalImpact: Save a balloon style, a credits block, a title treatment; reuse it in the next issue.
entries.evidenceProse: Style catalogues are per-document; no cross-document object library exists.

entries.title: Optical margin alignment
entries.professionalImpact: Hanging punctuation is the difference between typeset and word-processed.
entries.evidenceProse: Appears only as a hardcoded OpticalMarginAlignment="false" in src/lib/paperIdmlExport.ts:274.

entries.title: Track changes and editorial redlining
entries.professionalImpact: Editors mark up; writers accept or reject. Without it the edit happens in another app.
entries.evidenceProse: Appears only as a hardcoded TrackChanges="false" in src/lib/paperIdmlExport.ts:273.

entries.title: In-document review comments
entries.professionalImpact: Client and editor notes pinned to the page they refer to.
entries.evidenceProse: No Paper comment or annotation model found; Video's review annotations are separate and local-only.

entries.title: EPUB export
entries.professionalImpact: Reflowable ebook output is half of independent publishing revenue.
entries.evidenceProse: EPUB appears only as an import extension in src/lib/mediaFormatRegistry.ts:53; no export path exists.

entries.title: IDML import
entries.professionalImpact: Export to InDesign works; coming back from a collaborator does not.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/861: IDML export is real and Scribus-verified; import remains an honest-error stub.

entries.title: Barcode and ISBN placement
entries.professionalImpact: Every printed book cover needs a correctly sized, quiet-zoned barcode.
entries.evidenceProse: No barcode or ISBN generation found.

entries.title: Real-time collaboration
entries.professionalImpact: Two people in one document, with presence and live cursors.
entries.evidenceProse: yjs, y-webrtc and peerjs sit unused in package.json; the shipped model is a single-active-editor LAN baton handoff.

entries.title: Cloud project sync
entries.professionalImpact: Start on the desktop, continue on the laptop, without carrying a file.
entries.evidenceProse: Cross-device continuity is LAN-paired; no cloud project store exists.

entries.title: Team review with server authority
entries.professionalImpact: A share link, timecoded client comments, approvals that everyone can see.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999: review is "local file exchange only" and makes "no cloud/team-authority claim."

entries.title: A plugin and extension SDK
entries.professionalImpact: Third-party effects, brush packs, node packs, custom panels — the thing that makes a tool an ecosystem.
entries.evidenceProse: No plugin host or extension API found; provider packs are the only extension point. TASK_LIST.md:18 defers sandboxed plug-ins past the qualified core.

entries.title: Scripting and headless automation
entries.professionalImpact: A studio wants to drive exports from a script or a build server, not by hand.
entries.evidenceProse: No public scripting API, user-script runtime, or headless CLI entry point found.

entries.title: A cross-project asset catalogue
entries.professionalImpact: Tags, ratings, EXIF/XMP, duplicate detection and search across every project, not one at a time.
entries.evidenceProse: Smart bins and media logging exist inside Video's Source Library only (docs/notes/999); no cross-project catalogue or metadata read/write exists.

entries.title: AAF and broadcast wrappers
entries.professionalImpact: OTIO, FCP7 XML and CMX 3600 EDL all round-trip. AAF, MXF, IMF and DCP do not.
entries.evidenceProse: src/lib/videoProfessionalInterchange.ts:305 — importAaf() returns never, with the explicit reason that AAF is "not implemented". No MXF/IMF/DCP packaging exists.

entries.title: Broadcast caption embedding
entries.professionalImpact: CEA-608/708 and SCC muxed into the file, not shipped beside it.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999: "CEA-608/708, SCC, and embedded caption muxing remain explicitly unavailable."

entries.title: Decoded-signal QC
entries.professionalImpact: Automatic detection of black frames, freezes, silence, flash hazards and gamut violations before delivery.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999: "Black/freeze/silence/flash/true-peak/gamut analysis still needs native decoded-media analyzers."

entries.title: External monitoring and control surfaces
entries.professionalImpact: An SDI, NDI or HDMI reference monitor, and a jog/shuttle or fader panel.
entries.evidenceProse: docs/notes/999: "External SDI monitoring and control surfaces need device-specific native work."

entries.title: Rotoscoping and tracking that run
entries.professionalImpact: Mask keyframes and tracking planners are modelled; no analysis engine solves them.
entries.evidenceProse: Tracking and stabilization exist as planners across ~10 modules with no solver; TASK_LIST.md:18 defers the VFX workspace.

entries.title: Production-grade chroma key
entries.professionalImpact: Spill suppression, matte refinement, garbage masks and edge control — not just a preview.
entries.evidenceProse: Only src/lib/chromaKeyPreview.ts exists; no full keyer.

entries.title: Audio repair and auto-ducking
entries.professionalImpact: De-noise, de-hum, de-ess, and music that steps back under dialogue.
entries.evidenceProse: No audio-repair or sidechain/ducking processing found in the audio pipeline.

entries.title: Broader hardware encoding and alpha export
entries.professionalImpact: NVENC, QuickSync and VideoToolbox alongside VAAPI, plus a transparent-video preset.
entries.evidenceProse: Hardware encode ships VAAPI and CPU only; no alpha-capable export preset is shipped.

entries.title: Starter templates and a recipe gallery
entries.professionalImpact: An empty graph teaches nothing. Working examples are how a node tool gets adopted.
entries.evidenceProse: No cross-project flow template library; TASK_LIST.md:834 F10 keeps "actionable empty states + starter templates" open.

entries.title: Scheduled and triggered runs
entries.professionalImpact: A watch folder, a webhook, a nightly run — turning a graph into a service.
entries.evidenceProse: No webhook, HTTP-trigger or scheduled-run entry point exists for graphs; watch folders serve video ingest only.

entries.title: Resumable batch runs over a dataset
entries.professionalImpact: Point a graph at 500 rows, walk away, resume after a failure without starting over.
entries.evidenceProse: No run queue or resumable batch execution found.

entries.title: Shareable node packs
entries.professionalImpact: Publish a graph or a custom node so someone else can install it.
entries.evidenceProse: Flows live only inside .sloom projects; no packaging or import path for user-authored nodes exists.

entries.title: Tagged PDF and PDF/UA
entries.professionalImpact: Accessible reading order, alt text and language — increasingly a contract requirement for institutional publishing.
entries.evidenceProse: No tagged-PDF structure or PDF/UA validation in the Paper PDF pipeline.

entries.title: An iPad and iOS build
entries.professionalImpact: The tablet market for drawing and layout apps is overwhelmingly iPad.
entries.evidenceProse: The mobile target is Android-only — capacitor.config.ts, android/, and the Play pipeline.

entries.title: A usable phone Video timeline and Flow shell
entries.professionalImpact: On a phone the Video timeline crams to the point of hiding tracks, and Flow has no phone layout at all.
entries.evidenceProse: TASK_LIST.md:170 open — "the Video mobile-shell timeline cramming (can't see a track)"; Flow lacks a phone shell.
